deploymentEvidence.sourceType: pinned official BSC deployment configuration independently corroborated by exact-address Sourcify deployment record
deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official ApeSwapFinance migration-config.js explicitly lists this router, factory and WBNB in the bsc/bsc-fork branch. Independently, Sourcify returns chain 56 and this exact address, deployment transaction/block, compiled ApeRouter and non-proxy resolution; its encoded constructor arguments agree with the official factory and WBNB. The deployed router full source matches the pinned official ApeRouter.sol after CRLF normalization and trimming.
limitations: BscScan direct contract requests returned HTTP 403; its indexed title labels this address ApeSwap: ApeRouter, but explorer ABI retrieval was not used.
Sourcify legacy repository full_match metadata URL returned HTTP 404; the v2 exact-address record succeeded and supplies the full ABI, metadata and sources.
No independent live RPC bytecode, state, configuration or execution check was performed.

abiEvidence.sourceType: exact-address Sourcify v2 full ABI, metadata and verified source
abiEvidence.normalizedSourceHashRecipe: Normalize CRLF to LF, trim surrounding whitespace, then SHA-256 the complete UTF-8 source bytes.
abiEvidence.evidence: The complete ABI below is copied from the abi field of Sourcify v2 for chain 56 and this exact address, retaining constructor, all 24 functions and receive. Selected function ABI objects are copied unchanged from that array. Sourcify reports exact_match for creation and runtime; these are verification-service reports, not an independent current runtime attestation. This is a direct ApeRouter, not a proxy or generic Uniswap ABI substitution.

libraryBinding.deployedSwapArithmetic: amountInWithFee = amountIn * 998; denominator = reserveIn * 1000 + amountInWithFee; inverse quote likewise uses 1000/998.
libraryBinding.evidence: The pinned official router source matches, but the repository library at this commit has a different pair init-code hash. Therefore the verified deployment library, not the repository library, is authoritative for this admission. No claim of whole-repository/dependency identity is made. Reviewed deployed source has immutable factory/WETH, deterministic pair addresses, fixed 998/1000 swap arithmetic and no configurable router fee/reward hook, ownership function, executor or multicall.

reviewSummary.selection: Nine explicit exact-input/exact-output swaps including three fee-on-transfer variants, plus five non-permit liquidity functions.
reviewSummary.exclusions: Seven read-only/pure getters/quote helpers and three LP permit/signature entry points.
runtimeRisks: Payable ETH-named methods spend BNB, and WETH is constructor-bound WBNB on BSC.
Caller-specified tokens, paths, recipients, amounts, slippage minimums and deadlines remain caller responsibilities; approvals and LP approvals are separately required.
Deployed library fixes the factory pair derivation and 998/1000 quote arithmetic; official repository library at the pinned commit has a different pair init-code hash and is not substituted.

Fee-on-transfer token/native removal forwards whole-router token balance; supporting token/native swaps unwrap whole-router WBNB balance. Pre-existing balances and token taxes can change results; removal minimums do not ensure post-tax recipient receipt.
Pool/token state, token callbacks, tax/rebase behavior, native receipt, liquidity and execution remain unverified. No grants, pauses, signing boundaries or execution controls are changed.
